verses.1: Let us praise the righteous in the Lord, those who are holy and righteous.
verses.2: Praise the LORD in the temple at Bethel. Sing His praises!
verses.3: They sang a new song; they played it well with great skill.
verses.4: For it is true what Jehovah says, and all His actions are genuine.
verses.5: He loves righteousness and justice. The LORD is full of kindness; the earth is filled with His goodness.
verses.6: By the word of the LORD, the heavens were created; and by His breath, all creatures were made.
verses.7: Whoever enters from the sea is given treasures as a reward.
verses.8: All the nations of the earth shall fear Jehovah; all those who dwell in Tabor will flee from him.
verses.9: For he said, and it became his commandment; and he stood firm.
verses.10: YHWH has revealed the plans of nations, removing them from their calculations.
verses.11: The LORD’s command will always stand firm in the hearts of people, from generation to generation.
verses.12: The people of that nation, whom Jehovah, their God, chose as their land.
verses.13: From heaven, Jehovah looked down and saw all of mankind.
verses.14: From his throne, he watched over all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.15: He united their hearts, so that they could understand all his actions.
verses.16: The king who is not righteous cannot be saved through great strength.
verses.17: The false horse cannot be ridden; with its large army, it cannot move forward.
verses.18: Now, let the eyes of Jehovah be open to those who fear Him, so that He may show them His kindness.
verses.19: To save their souls from death and to keep them alive during famine.
verses.20: Our souls waited for Jehovah’s help. He saved us from harm.
verses.21: For in him our hearts shall rejoice, for in his holy name we have placed our trust.
verses.22: May your kindness be upon us, O LORD, as we begin to serve you.
